description.en: Sets the team's "Friendship Points" value, either as an absolute value or (when the second argument is truthy) as a delta added to/subtracted from the current value, mirroring CMND_SET_PASSION_PT.
Value to set, or delta to apply when useDelta is true.
Optional; when true, applies `value` as a delta instead of setting it directly.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (no value given, or required engine/script state not ready).
